title: Bloodline Awakening
next_chapter_hook: An old yet familiar voice echoed from deep within the bloodline—"You have finally arrived"

text.content: At the third quarter of the midnight hour, the oil lamp in the servants' quarters of the Tianqing Sect flickered unstably. Chen Ji sat cross-legged on the worn bed, spiritual energy flowing around him as usual, but his complexion was paler than usual. For three consecutive days he had been deducing intelligence on the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, and each use of the Tianji Record felt like flesh being cut by a blunt blade—that invisible Heavenly Fate Value was draining away at an imperceptible speed.

Just as he was about to conclude his meditation, a sudden chill ran down his spine. It was an indescribable perception—as if some existence beyond mortal will was gazing down from the nine heavens above. That gaze carried no emotion whatsoever, yet weighed like a thousand catties, pressing down until Chen Ji's meridians stagnated, and the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea began to vibrate on its own.

dialogue.content: (The gaze came without reason, yet felt like芒刺在背—as if the entire heavens and earth were scrutinizing an ant)

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, the brilliant light in his pupils vanishing in an instant. He suppressed the churning in his heart and slightly bowed in the posture befitting atrashdisciple, attempting to hide that fleeting anomaly. Yet just then, beneath the skin of his chest, an ancient pattern dormant for years began to faintly heat up.

That pattern lay deep within his bloodline, present since childhood like a birthmark, never showing any abnormality. Chen Ji had secretly examined it countless times, sensing something indescribably powerful sealed within, yet never able to awaken it. Sect physicians all said it was merely ordinary blood variation, nothing serious. Now, the moment that gaze descended, this seal began to vibrate on its own.

choice.prompt: The bloodline seal was triggered by the gaze, and Chen Ji felt something awakening within him. How should he respond to this sudden mutation?

choices.description: Risk guiding that power, let the seal shatter, and see the truth hidden within.
choices.risk_hint: May expose true strength and invite unpredictable danger

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes slightly, his divine sense slowly probing into the bloodline pattern on his chest. The seal was more ancient than he had imagined, its contents seemingly dormant for ten thousand years, gradually awakening with that gaze. A burning force spread from his heart, rushing straight to his mind.

choices.description: Use the power of the Tianji Record Fragment to conceal his aura, reseal the seal, and prevent any existence from noticing.
choices.risk_hint: May miss the opportunity to understand one's own secrets
choices.process_label: recite tianji lu mantra, wrap chest with remnant power

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment hummed and buzzed, golden patterns spreading from Chen Ji's palm, attempting to envelop the agitated seal. Yet that gaze seemed to pierce through the Fragment's concealment, and the substantial pressure suddenly increased by threefold. Chen Ji grunted, fine beads of cold sweat appearing at his temples.

choices.description: Consume Heavenly Fate Value to activate the Tianji Record and deduce the cause and danger level of this mutation.
choices.risk_hint: Is the precious Heavenly Fate Value worth spending here?
choices.process_label: take tianji lu remnant, dive into divination

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment unfolded on its own, golden characters moving like living things. However, that gaze seemed to sense something, and the deduction was forced to stop the moment it began. Chen Ji felt sharp pain between his brows, a mouthful of blood rising in his throat—something was preventing him from glimpsing the truth.

While he wrestled with the seal, that gaze from the Void suddenly withdrew three-tenths of its pressure, becoming playful instead. As if an invisible eye带着某种scrutinizing was carefully examining the power stirring in his bloodline.

"Interesting." A voice，detached至极， rang in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, neither male nor female, indistinguishable in age, "The chess piece of this generation, has it finally begun to sprout?" The voice entered directly into his soul, bypassing the eardrums, leaving no trace, as if Heaven itself were whispering.

dialogue.content: (The two words "chess piece" exploded like thunder, Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—could the origins of the Tianji Record, his fate, have been arranged from the very beginning?)

text.content: However, that voice did not continue, only that gaze intensified by another three-tenths. The bloodline pattern on Chen Ji's chest suddenly vibrated violently, and something within the depths of the seal was frantically battering against its constraints. A power more ancient and more chaotic than the Tianji Record was being forcibly awakened from its slumber.

choice.prompt: The power leaking from the seal's cracks caused Chen Ji splitting headaches, countless unfamiliar scenes flickering through his mind like a carousel. He had to make a choice—

choices.description: Do not resist, let those scenes flood into his soul, even if it might damage his sanity.
choices.risk_hint: May cause temporary loss of consciousness or mental confusion
choices.process_label: chen ji grits teeth, images flood consciousness

text.content: The scenes flooded in like a breached dam. A majestic altar stood atop the nine heavens, countless figures prostrating in worship. At the center of the altar, a blurry figure stood with hands behind its back, surrounded by golden totems identical to the pattern on Chen Ji's chest. The next instant, the scene shattered into scattered light points and dissolved.

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record Fragment as the core to construct a soul defense, completely isolating those unfamiliar memories.
choices.risk_hint: May provoke the existence within the seal
choices.process_label: build barrier with remnant power, block visions

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment blazed with golden light, forcibly keeping those scenes at bay. However, just as the barrier closed, an old yet majestic voice rang out from the depths of the seal—"My blood descendant, how can you flinch from battle!" That voice carried undeniable pressure, directly causing blood to seep from all seven apertures of Chen Ji's head.

That gaze from the Void suddenly withdrew its pressure, as if merely passing by and casting a casual glance. Yet the moment it vanished, the ancient seal within Chen Ji finally cracked open a gap. A wisp of turbid blood energy spilled from the gap, instantly merging with his spiritual power.

Chen Ji felt that what flowed through his meridians was no longer merely spiritual power, but a more domineering, more primal force. That power carried the breath of primordial chaos, as if awakening from eternal slumber, surging through every meridian with unstoppable momentum.

The Tianji Record Fragment vibrated frantically, golden characters constantly restructuring and deducing, spontaneously evolving a cryptic message—"Heavenly Fate Clan Remnant Bloodline, Ancient Priest's Blood, Bloodline Awakening Degree: Three Percent." Chen Ji stared at these words, his heart shaken. Heavenly Fate Clan? Ancient Priest? He had never seen this name in any text.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji forcefully suppressed his churning thoughts, hiding all his shock in the depths of those placid, well-like eyes—someday, he would demand the truth of all this, with interest.)

choice.prompt: After the bloodline initially awakened, Chen Ji felt an indescribable power added within him. And though that gaze had departed, it seemed to have left some mark. How should he respond?

choices.text: Investigate the Mystery of His Origins
choices.description: Search through sect secret archives for any records concerning the Heavenly Fate Clan.
choices.risk_hint: The investigation process may alert those with ulterior motives

text.content: Chen Ji got off the bed, and under cover of night, crept toward the Scripture Library. Beneath the moonlight, his silhouette moved like a specter among the rooftops. However, what he did not know was that deep within the Scripture Library, a pair of turbid old eyes was watching his departing direction through layers of barriers.

choices.description: Return to his quarters and temper his meridians with the newly awakened bloodline power to strengthen his foundation.
choices.visible_reward: Bloodline Initially Stabilized, Combat Power Slightly Increased
choices.risk_hint: May Miss the Best Timing for Investigation
choices.process_label: quietly return, digest this awakening first

text.content: Returning to his quarters, Chen Ji sat cross-legged, using the Tianji Record Fragment as a guide to slowly channel the newly born power within. That turbid blood energy continuously blended with his original spiritual power, strangely producing some kind of resonance. His originally fragile meridians gradually strengthened under the tempering, and the spiritual liquid in his dantian also became more concentrated.

choices.description: Contact the Demonic Path Saint Maiden Ye Qing through secret methods, using her Demonic Path mist to conceal the anomaly.
choices.risk_hint: May Allow Ye Qing to Perceive More Truth
choices.process_label: take blood jade slip, quietly activate

text.content: The Jade Slip vibrated, a ghostly demonic aura overflowed from it, transforming into Ye Qing's enchanting yet cold voice: "Young Master Chen disturbs people in the deep night, could it be you have encountered some trouble?" Chen Ji briefly explained the mutation, and a light laugh came from within the demonic aura: "Interesting, the thing within you is probably even more complicated than my Demonic Path mist."

Just then, that dormant gaze descended once more, heavier and more scrutinizing than before. Chen Ji felt the space around him seemed to solidify, an invisible force piercing through layers of roof tiles, directly locking onto the bloodline pattern on his chest that had just awakened.

The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly emitted a sharp hum, golden characters flickering frantically, seemingly warning of something. Chen Ji's heart tightened—he had never felt such a close connection between himself and the Tianji Record, as if the Fragment was somehow shielding him from something.

However this time, that gaze did not depart, instead surging in like a tide, carrying a certain probing and provocation. Chen Ji felt the bloodline pattern on his chest beat violently, an unprecedented sharp pain spreading from his heart to every limb. In the depths of the seal, something was awakening, responding to that beyond-mortal will.

Chen Ji clenched his fists tightly, his knuckles white. He had walked the world for years under the persona of atrash, his plans never failing, never placing himself in danger. Yet now, facing this gaze beyond comprehension, he felt a deep helplessness. An ant could still struggle, but he could not even find a direction to struggle. But even so, there was not a trace of fear in his eyes—only cold calculation and smoldering rage.

Just then, an old yet familiar voice suddenly rang out from deep within the bloodline, as if traversing endless years, carrying a certain settled tranquility. That voice held only one word, yet thundered in Chen Ji's spiritual depths—
